offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures generic prescription drugs, especially controlled-release and abuse-deterrent formulations, for pharmaceutical companies. Sells finished products to marketing partners and earns development, milestone and royalty income from partner-marketed drugs.

primary_products.value: controlled-release generic tablets; abuse-deterrent opioid formulations; oral generic pharmaceuticals

primary_services.value: contract drug development; contract manufacturing; formulation development

customer_segment.value: B2B: generic drug marketers and pharmaceutical companies that license or purchase its formulations

revenue_model.value: product sales: finished generic drug products sold to marketing partners; licensing or royalties: royalties on partner-marketed products; project or contract: development fees and milestone payments from partners
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes generic drugs in its own facility, sold to pharmaceutical partners; service provider: contract development and manufacturing for pharmaceutical companies

geography_served.value: US national: products marketed by partners across the United States

specialization.value: niche specialist: generic controlled-release and abuse-deterrent drug formulations

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: pharmaceutical marketing partners that sell the finished drugs; direct sales: sales to pharmaceutical companies under development and supply agreements

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval of generic drugs and manufacturing compliance, DEA controls on controlled substances

notes: Current product portfolio and partner arrangements may have changed; details are based on my general knowledge.
